title: Appointment Scheduling Terms for Patients: Cancellation Notice, Reschedule Allowance and Cancellation Channels
content:
For each visit type booked through **Appointment Scheduling** at Riverbend Regional Health, a patient's cancellation or rescheduling of an appointment is governed by the terms and figures below.

## Terms

1. **Late-cancellation window.** A patient cancellation inside the stated number of hours before the scheduled start counts as late.
2. **How notice is measured.** For every visit type, cancellation notice is measured in hours before the scheduled start.
3. **Reschedule allowance.** The patient may reschedule an appointment up to the stated number of times before it must be cancelled and rebooked.
4. **Rescheduling inside the window.** For every visit type, rescheduling inside the late-cancellation window counts as a late cancellation.
5. **Cancellation channels.** The patient may cancel through the channels stated for the visit type; portal cancellation is available only where marked.
6. **Waitlist offer.** A slot freed within the stated number of hours before its start is offered to the waitlist.
7. **Appointments Riverbend cancels.** For every visit type, a patient whose appointment Riverbend cancels gets the first available slot and no fee.

## Figures by visit type

| Visit type | Late-cancellation window (hours before start) | Reschedules allowed per appointment | Cancellation channels | Portal cancellation | Waitlist offer window (hours before start) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | 24 | 3 | patient portal, call center, SMS reply | allowed | 48 |
| Telehealth Video Visit | 2 | 3 | patient portal, call center, SMS reply | allowed | 24 |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | 24 | 2 | patient portal, call center, SMS reply | allowed | 72 |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | 24 | 2 | patient portal, call center | allowed | 48 |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | 48 | 4 | patient portal, call center | allowed | 72 |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | 24 | 2 | patient portal, call center | allowed | 24 |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | 72 | 2 | call center | not allowed | 96 |

Settings that are the same for all seven visit types:

| Setting | Value for every visit type |
|---|---|
| How cancellation notice is measured | hours before the scheduled start |
| Rescheduling inside the late-cancellation window counts as a late cancellation | yes |
| First available slot and no fee when Riverbend cancels | yes |

## Hypothetical readings

- *Hypothetical:* a patient cancels an Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment 30 hours before its scheduled start. The visit type's window is 48 hours, and 30 hours lies inside it, so the cancellation counts as late. The same 30 hours of notice on a Primary Care Office Visit (window 24 hours) lies outside the window.
- *Hypothetical:* an Outpatient Procedure Appointment can be cancelled only through the call center; portal cancellation is not allowed for it.
